323-4279-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-4279-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3099-4824-6723.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-4824-6723.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

4742-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-6094.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-5789.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1349-3967-5239.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
1349-3967-5239.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its ability from Enduring Bondwarden and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4772-6441-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

277-2893-3875-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Tireless Provisioner and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}
Repeat.

2511-2946-4871-6248.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2511-2946-4871-6248.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-850-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-7296.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

147-3125-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
147-3125-6798.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Dualcaster Mage and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5078-6650-7444.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1806-2060-3129-5147-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

5078-5741-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat

240-969-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7228.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two instant and/or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
6798-6972-7228.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

465-4605-6797-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-4605-6797-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

1692-3129-7150.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Helm of the Host trigger, creating two token copies of Kirol that aren't legendary.
Holding priority, activate the Kirol token by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

24-1640-5356.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Barbed Servitor instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Barbed Servitor triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt.
24-1640-5356.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

851-2557-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
851-2557-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev and Parallel Lives.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
851-2557-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2034-6754-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

5310-5686-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
5310-5686-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

3129-5525-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3129-5525-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Llanowar Loamspeaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

874-1170-1329-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.

Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2741-3490-4659-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-3490-4659-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

431-1308-2557-3129.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2871-4258-5195.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Storm-Kiln Artist, Blood Funnel and Sedgemoor Witch trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Resolve the Sedgemoor Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Pest token.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

3614-6712-6781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that has haste and/or flash.
3614-6712-6781.description:
Cast Heroic Intervention by paying {1}{G}, giving permanents you control hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Shaman by sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.
Sonic's second ability triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that was dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

5256-6014-6659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5256-5921.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-2079.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

877-3249-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard that can be cast by paying {0} due to Morophon.
877-3249-5231.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature cast in step 2, adding {R}.
Repeat.

222-308-997-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-997-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4419-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4613-5507.description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat using the Human token instead.

3259-5223-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Magda, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may use it to activate Urza's second ability.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Foothill Guide, adding {W}.
When Foothill Guide dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Foothill Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Foothill Guide's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.

Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Tree of Perdition that is a 0/0 Construct with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Electropotence triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Electropotence trigger, causing you to pay {2}{R} to have the Tree of Perdition token deal damage equal to its power to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.

1563-1849-2143.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4647-5254-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power four or greater.
4647-5254-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power four or greater.
The creature dies, triggering Warbeast of Gorgoroth twice, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1010-2034-3374.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Arcbound Prototype persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype, adding {C}{C}.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular and persist abilities trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting all +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Prototype onto another artifact creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1283-1978-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Chromatic Orrery that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 2.
1283-1978-5159.notes: You can also use Mishra's Warform's second ability to draw cards if mana allows on a particular iteration.

687-1483-4050.description:
Pay {2}{B} to cast Weaponcraft Enthusiast, choosing to create two Servos on ETB.
Pay {3} to activate Tayam's ability, removing the three Vigilance counters created with Tayam.
In response, sacrifice Weaponcraft Enthusiast and both Servos to Phyrexian Altar to create {3}.
Choose to return Weaponcraft Enthusiast to the battlefield as Tayam's ability resolves, choosing to create two Servos on ETB.
Repeat.

1719-3147-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1719-3147-3525.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
